name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with system preference as the default dark mode, but add a persistent toggle in settings. This ensures immediate visual comfort for most users while respecting individual preference—accepting the trade-off of slightly slower first-time setup for long-term satisfaction. Dark mode aligns with competitive analysis (Dark theme, Graphify Dashboard) and reduces eye strain during extended use. The toggle keeps the interface flexible without cluttering the initial experience.

name: Pane
text: The real risk is locking users into a choice they may regret—once they toggle dark mode, they’re stuck with it unless they dig into settings again. A better alternative is a one-time selector at first launch, paired with a persistent but reversible toggle; this respects user agency without forcing a second decision later. Settle it with a quick user test: measure how many users change their initial choice within a week.
